name: ArmsOfSolitaire BETA
desc:
🎮 ArmsOfSolitaire ( formerly AceOfSpadez ) is a sandbox, first person shooter with voxel worlds that can be modified through building, digging and destruction.

Update BETA 3.4.3
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/update/4598046

Premium grants +15% match bonus.

This game is a tribute to the original Ace Of Spades from 2011 made by Ben Aksoy.
